predecessor.law_reuse: E2 imports the E1 B3 law (recovery, impulse, clamp, event order law) from the frozen E1 experiment modules; nothing is reimplemented and E1 is never modified.

research_question: Does the E1-supported B3 bounded state-retention mechanism remain stable, recoverable, useful as a recent-history carrier, and free from pathological accumulation when driven by contract-valid synthetic Appraisal sequences shaped more like plausible CharacterOS inputs?
production_shaped_status: This is an engineering coverage distribution consistent with current canonical Appraisal contracts. It is NOT an observed, calibrated, representative, or provider-estimated production distribution.

mechanisms.b1: NOT implemented (E1 established equivalence with B3_RESET for this purpose)
mechanisms.b2: frozen production ReferenceFastEmaAffectProducer, imported lawfully, native reporting only, cannot decide the verdict

canonical_appraisal_shape.validators: every generated event passes validateExperienceAppraisalProposalV0; record fixtures pass validateExperienceAppraisalRecordV0
canonical_appraisal_shape.insufficient_context: INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT is represented as NO accepted appraisal event at that tick: no dimensions are fabricated and no Affect impulse exists. E2 families contain only accepted appraisals.

families.description: quiet: 18 events from 9000 eligible ticks; D1 amplitude mix; balanced ordinary goal pairs
chatter: 1080 LOW events in [0,10800) at rate .10; fixed 8-goal cycle; complementary entries share q
ordinary: 192 events from 9600 eligible ticks; ordinary amplitude mixture; strictly balanced goal pairs
negative burst: 10 D1-like background events in [0,1000) + 50 burst events every 2 ticks from t=1000; burst goal ~ U[0,.20)
positive burst: exact D4 timing/q with goal_D5 = 1 - goal_D4 (symmetry pair)
alternating: events at 0,18,...,10566; amplitude LOW .70 / MID .30; 7-goal cycle x 84; complementary entries share q
high density stress: 2700 events in [0,10800) at rate .25; D7 amplitude mixture; strictly balanced goal pairs

long run: 10 cycles of 10000 ticks; per cycle 4 D1-like + 80 D3-like + 100 D2-like + 50 burst (every 2 ticks) + 18 D1-like; even-cycle bursts negative, odd-cycle bursts mirror with same q; per-cycle quiet [c+8800, c+9999]

probes.replay: per mechanism (B0/B2/B3_RESET/B3): same id+payload -> REPLAY delta 0; same id changed payload -> CONFLICT; different id same payload -> APPLIED

run_accounting.counting_law: replay/restore/partition sub-steps are probe internals, not separate probe executions; 928 + 20 + 64 + 8 + 6 + 4 = 1030

metrics.bound_occupancy: O_v- = mean(v <= -1+eps); O_v+ = mean(v >= 1-eps); O_a- = mean(a <= eps); O_a+ = mean(a >= 1-eps)
metrics.near_bound_occupancy: N_v = mean(|v| >= .9); N_a+ = mean(a >= .9); N_a- = mean(a <= .1)
metrics.event_sensitivity: J_i = max(|v_post - v_pre|, |a_post - a_pre|) per event; q buckets [0,.01) [.01,.04) [.04,.16) [.16,.36) [.36,1]; per bucket count/medianJ/p90J/clampFraction/J<.005 fraction/J>=.02 fraction
metrics.gain_checks: unsaturated: Delta_a/q ~ .20 and Delta_v/(q*(2g-1)) ~ .25; max error recorded, never used for tuning
metrics.strong_debt: mean(a >= .4 AND ticks_since_latest_event_with_q>=.25 >= 300); ticks_since = t - t_latest_strong with t_latest_strong = -1 when none exists (so ticks_since = t+1); an event AT t is 0 ticks ago
metrics.quiet_debt: mean(a - .2 > .02 + 1e-12 AND no event in previous 600 ticks); previous-600 window is (t-600, t] inclusive of t
metrics.saturation_episodes: exact-bound predicate (any of the four §41 bounds); maximal contiguous intervals; count, max duration, p95 duration nearest-rank
metrics.state_change_sparsity: per q bucket: fractions of J < .005, .005 <= J < .02, J >= .02
metrics.recovery_window: for each declared quiet window [s,e]: expected_v(t) = v_s*exp(-(t-s)/150), expected_a(t) = .2 + (a_s-.2)*exp(-(t-s)/150); max axis error, monotonicity violations (d_(t+1) <= d_t + 1e-15), d_e/d_s when d_s nonzero
metrics.activation_reconstruction: after the latest activation-clamp anchor s (or 0 if never clamped): a_t-.2 = (a_s-.2)*exp(-(t-s)/150) + .20*sum(q_i*exp(-(t-t_i)/150)) while no further clamping occurs; reconstruction max error recorded
metrics.path_dependence: D_pre/D_post = norm_inf of A-vs-B state difference at the common final event (pre/post); also recorded at t=2100 and t=2700
metrics.b2_native: channel intensity bound/near-bound occupancy, replacement/upsert counts, routed emotion counts, ACTIVE/RELEASING phase occupancy, quiet recovery, mood occupancy at .25 and .225; no VA translation; no B3-vs-B2 winner

gates.statement: Protocol integrity: frozen manifest binds baseline, source fingerprints, E1 law fingerprint, E1 evidence fingerprint, generator hash, all seeds, corpus Merkle root, formulas, parameters, gates, run count (1030), zero-model flag, production-diff law. All 232 lifetimes and probes validate; any mismatch invalidates the experiment.
Finite/bounded: all B3/B3_RESET samples finite, -1 <= v <= 1, 0 <= a <= 1; additionally B3 a >= .2 - 1e-12 so O_a- = 0 and N_a- = 0.
Time consistency: partition probes (D2-S00/D3-S00/D7-S00/D8-S00, B3, tick1/tick10/direct) max_abs_error <= 1e-12.
Restore/replay: 6 restore continuations max_abs_error <= 1e-12 with no historical rerun; replay REPLAY delta 0, changed-payload CONFLICT, different-ID APPLIED for all four mechanisms.
Ignored fields: C4 vs C5 B3 trajectories max_abs_error <= 1e-12 (payload hashes need not match).

Quiet recovery: every declared quiet window model_error <= 1e-12, d monotone (<= 1e-15 slack), at +600 d <= d_start*exp(-4)+1e-12 and at +1200 d <= d_start*exp(-8)+1e-12 (where the window extends that far), quiet_debt = 0; for D4/D5/D7 if exact-bound at final active input the first recovery tick must leave the exact bound.
Ordinary saturation: D1, D2, D3 separately Q95_seed(O_v- + O_v+) <= .005, Q95_seed(O_a+) <= .005, Q95_seed(N_v) <= .020, Q95_seed(N_a+) <= .020.

Balanced valence drift: machine-checked |sum(q_i*(2g_i-1))| <= 1e-12 for every balanced distribution; outputs: D1/D2/D3/D6 |grand_mean(mu_v)| <= .01 and Q95_seed(|mu_v|) <= .05; D7 <= .02 / <= .10; D8 <= .02 / max_seed <= .05; D4/D5 symmetry |v_D4+v_D5| <= 1e-12 and |a_D4-a_D5| <= 1e-12 at all common checkpoints.

Under-response (D3): pooled fraction(J >= .02) >= .25; pooled fraction(J < .005) <= .70; pooled unsaturated MID/STRONG/EDGE fraction(J + 1e-12 >= .02) >= .75; across seeds count(B_.05 > .95) <= 3 of 32.

History retention: >= 15/16 pairs qualify (unsaturated, D_pre >= .05); every qualified pair: B3 |D_post - D_pre| <= 1e-12, B3_RESET D_post <= 1e-12, B3 at 2100 D <= D_post*exp(-4)+1e-12 and at 2700 D <= D_post*exp(-8)+1e-12. Instantaneous-retention failure is a core mechanism failure; too few qualifying histories is a mapping/coverage risk (distinguished).
Cancellation activation (D6): Q95_seed(mean(|v| <= .05 AND a >= .6)) <= .05 and Q95_seed(strong_debt) <= .05.
D8 long run: EVERY seed O_v- + O_v+ <= .02, O_a+ <= .02, N_v <= .10, N_a+ <= .10, B_.05 >= .20 (n=8 so p95 = max; enforced per seed).
D7 stress: no saturation ceiling; require finite, bounded, saturation recorded, post-input recovery, and the quiet-recovery gate to pass for D7. B3 is not rejected merely for saturating under D7.

order: B. any core dynamics failure (finite/bounds, partition, restore/replay, recovery law, qualified-history immediate retention) -> MECHANISM_NOT_SUPPORTED_UNDER_PRODUCTION_SHAPED_INPUT
C. core good + distribution gate failures -> SUPPORTED_WITH_IDENTIFIED_MAPPING_RISK with all triggered sub-risk codes

sub_risk_codes.RELEVANCE_INTENSITY_MAPPING_RISK: G10 q/response failures or G11 too-few qualifying histories
sub_risk_codes.RECOVERY_TIMESCALE_RISK: operational baseline/quiet problem with the exact law still correct

no_retune_law: If E2 returns SUPPORTED_WITH_IDENTIFIED_MAPPING_RISK, no coefficient, tau, q rule, baseline, corpus or gate may change inside E2. The result is final evidence; follow-up work is E2A only (documented, not run).

e2a_design_only.trigger_retention_failure: replay saved impulses with only retain/reset switched
e2a_design_only.trigger_gain_risk: 0.5x / 1x / 2x impulse scale on the failing axis
e2a_design_only.discipline: same corpus hashes; one factor only; relevant family; first 8 seeds; new manifest; new verdict. NOT implemented or run by E2.

forbidden: sampling fewer ticks for tick-level metrics

zero_model_law: No OpenAI, Ollama, DeepSeek, Qwen or any evaluator/LLM call exists anywhere in E2. Real model calls: 0.
production_isolation_law: production source diff relative to the required baseline is empty; only research/experiments/affect-production-shaped-e2/ and evals/conformance/affect-production-shaped-e2.test.ts may change
